summary: Elijah says to Ahab I have not troubled Israel but you and father's house by forsaking commandments and following Baals, then gather all Israel and 450 prophets of Baal and 400 of Asherah to Mount Carmel. Elijah says how long will you waver between two opinions? If Yahweh is God follow him, if Baal then him, people answer not a word. Prophets of Baal take bull cut pieces lay on wood but put no fire, call on name Baal from morning to noon, limping around altar, cut themselves, no voice answers. Elijah mocks. Then Elijah repairs altar of Yahweh with 12 stones, trench, wood, bull cut, says fill four jars with water three times, water fills trench, then prays Yahweh God of Abraham Isaac Israel let it be known you are God and I your servant, fire falls consumes burnt offering wood stones dust licks water in trench, people fall on faces say Yahweh he is God. Elijah says seize prophets, brought to Kishon and killed. Then tells Ahab eat drink for sound of heavy rain, prays seven times servant sees cloud like man's hand, heavy rain, hand of Yahweh on Elijah runs before Ahab to Jezreel.
whyItMatters: Showdown — Baal vs Yahweh — fire from heaven, end of drought, but also shows prophet's humanity and Jezebel's retaliation next. Most cinematic story in Kings.

keyVerses.text: Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If Yahweh is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him.” The people didn’t say a word.
keyVerses.why: Call to decision — wavering between opinions.

keyVerses.text: Then Yahweh’s fire fell and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust; and it licked up the water that was in the trench.
keyVerses.why: Fire consumes offering, wood, stones, dust, water — total consumption.

keyVerses.text: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces. They said, “Yahweh, he is God! Yahweh, he is God!”

themes: how long waver between two opinions
rain after drought hand of Yahweh runs

questions.question: Who is Baal and why Mount Carmel showdown?
questions.answer: Baal is Canaanite storm god who supposedly brings rain, fertility. Israel under Ahab and Jezebel (Sidonian princess) had Baal worship official, Yahweh prophets killed. Drought for 3.5 years shows Baal not giving rain. Carmel is near sea, Baal's domain (storm from sea), contested sacred mountain. Elijah says if Yahweh God follow him if Baal follow him — call to exclusive loyalty like Joshua 24 choose today. How long limp between two branches (pasach — limping dance). People silent — indecision.

questions.question: Why do Baal prophets cut themselves and no answer?
questions.answer: Prophets of Baal call from morning to noon, limping around altar, Elijah mocks maybe sleeping, relieving himself, on journey. They cut with swords lances per custom until blood gushed — ecstatic self-injury to rouse deity. From morning to time of evening offering, no voice no answer no one who regarded. Silence emphasizes Baal's non-existence or impotence. Narrative uses time markers to show lengthy futility vs Yahweh's immediate fire.

questions.question: Why 12 stones and water three times?
questions.answer: Elijah repairs altar of Yahweh torn down — 12 stones for 12 tribes of Jacob (Israel), claiming unity of tribes even though divided kingdom. Trench large. Bull cut. Then says fill four jars water three times — total twelve jars like tribes, water poured saturates wood and fills trench, making miracle undeniable not trick. Fire falling licking water shows total consumption — Yahweh can bring fire even on water-soaked sacrifice, reversing expected need for dryness.

questions.question: Why after fire and confession, Elijah kills prophets and runs before Ahab in rain?
questions.answer: After fire, people say Yahweh he is God twice. Elijah says seize prophets of Baal, brings to Kishon brook and kills — according to law of Deuteronomy 13 false prophets leading astray. Then tells Ahab eat drink for sound of heavy rain (drought ending), prays, servant looks seven times, sees cloud like man's hand rising from sea, heavy rain comes, hand of Yahweh on Elijah so he runs before Ahab's chariot to Jezreel ~20 miles — prophetic empowerment, but also sets up Jezebel's threat next chapter which leads to Elijah's despair, showing even victorious prophet can crash.

glossary.def: Limp, dance between two branches — wavering loyalty.
Canaanite storm and fertility god, supposed bringer of rain.
Empowering presence enabling superhuman feat — running before chariot.
